question: A thief was spotted by a policeman at a distance of 1200 m and he started chasing him. The thief ran 6.4 km in 52 minutes and the policeman also ran the same distance in 40 minutes. Find the distance the thief had run before he was caught.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Thief was spotted by a policeman at 1200m

Thief ran 6.4km in 52 minutes

Policeman run the same distance in 40 minutes

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

When two objects run in the same direction then their relative speed,

⇒ Speed of one object - Speed of 2nd object
